mapper.sql: c.id AS id, c.goods_id AS goodsId, c.spec_id AS specId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.checked AS checked, g.name AS goodsName, g.cover AS cover, g.status AS goodsStatus, g.craftsman_id AS craftsmanId, s.spec_name AS specName, IFNULL(s.price, g.price) AS price, IFNULL(s.stock, g.stock) AS stock, CASE WHEN g.id IS NULL OR g.deleted = 1 THEN 1 WHEN g.status <> 1 OR g.audit_status <> 1 THEN 1 WHEN (CASE WHEN c.spec_id IS NULL THEN g.stock ELSE IFNULL(s.stock, 0) END) < c.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid, c.create_time AS createTime

FROM cart c LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = c.goods_id LEFT JOIN goods_spec s ON s.id = c.spec_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.id DESC
